name: vinyl-browser
description: Vinyl browser with sculpted glass controls, detachable tabs, an outward bookmark drawer and GitHub updates

scripts.build:win: node scripts/configure-build.js && electron-builder --config builder.generated.json --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.check: node --check main.js && node --check preload.js && node --check google-account.js && node --check updates.js && node --check store.js && node --check import-bookmarks.js && node --check home-data.js && node --check ui/app.js && node tests/store.test.js && node tests/chrome-bridge.test.js && node tests/google-account.test.js && node tests/updates.test.js && node tests/google-login-flow.test.js && node --check scripts/configure-build.js && node tests/import-bookmarks.test.js && node tests/home-data.test.js && node tests/release-config.test.js && node --check scripts/release-config.js && node --check scripts/check-release-tag.js && node tests/updater-lifecycle.test.js
scripts.publish:win: node scripts/configure-build.js --release && electron-builder --config builder.generated.json --win nsis --x64 --publish always
